verses.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन उवाच । ततो द्रौणिर्महाराज प्रययावर्जुनं रणे । तं पार्थः प्रतिजग्राह वायुवेगमिवोद्धतम् । शरजालेन महता वर्षमाणमिवाम्बुदम् ॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Then, Drona's son, O king, encountered Arjuna in battle. Partha then faced him, moving like the wind.

verses.sanskrit: तयोर्देवासुरसमः संनिपातो महानभूत् । किरतोः शरजालानि वृत्रवासवयोरिव ॥२॥
verses.english: O king, in the wrestling of the two mighty persons, resembling Vitra and Vasava respectively, they pulled, pressed, whirled and hurried down each other and struck each other with their knees and expressed their hatred for each other in loud voices.

verses.sanskrit: न स्म सूर्यस्तदा भाति न च वाति समीरणः । शरजालावृते व्योम्नि च्छायाभूते समन्ततः ॥३॥
verses.english: The sun then did not pour its rays and the wind did not blow. And they covered each other with a net-work of arrows, like Vritra and Vasava.

verses.sanskrit: महांश्चटचटाशब्दो योधयोर्हन्यमानयोः । दह्यतामिव वेणूनामासीत् परपुरञ्जय ॥४॥
verses.english: The sky was enveloped with shafts and there was a shade all around. When the two combatants fought with each other, there was a mighty cracking sound.

verses.sanskrit: हयानस्यार्जुनः सर्वान् कृतवानल्पजीवितान् । ते राजन्न प्रजानन्त दिशं काञ्चन मोहिताः ॥५॥
verses.english: Like that of bamboo's when on fire. O conqueror of enemies' cities, greatly assailed by Arjuna, his horses.

verses.sanskrit: ततो द्रौणिर्महार्वार्यः पार्थस्य विचरिष्यतः । विवरं सूक्ष्ममालोक्य ज्यां चिच्छेद क्षुरेण ह । तदस्यापूजयन् देवाः कर्म दृष्ट्वाऽतिमानुषम् ॥६॥
verses.english: Were so bewildered, that they could not make out which way to go. Then finding out the weak point of Partha, who was roving about, the highly powerful son of Drona cut off his bow-string with a sharp arrow. Beholding his superhuman deed, the deities spoke highly of him.
verses.bhavadeepa: न प्रजानन्त अडभाव आर्षः । न च ज्ञातवन्तः ॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणो भीष्मश्च कर्णश्च कृपश्चैव महारथाः । साधु साध्विति भाषन्तोऽपूजयन् कर्म तस्य तत् ॥७॥
verses.english: Exclaiming "Well-done Well-done" Drona, Bhishma, Karna, and the mighty carwarrior Kripa too, applauded his deed.

verses.sanskrit: ततो द्रौणिर्धनुः श्रेष्ठमपकृष्य रथर्षभम् । पुनरेवाहनत् पार्थं हृदये कङ्कपत्रिभिः ॥८॥
verses.english: Then drawing his that best of bows, the son of Drona again wounded Partha, the foremost of car-warriors, on the breast with Kanka-feathered shafts.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पार्थो महाबाहुः प्रहस्य स्वनवत् तदा । योजयामास नवया मौर्व्या गाण्डीवमोजसा ॥९॥
verses.english: Then, laughing, the mighty-armed Partha set a strong and fresh string to his Gandiva.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽर्धचन्द्रमावृत्य तेन पार्थः समागमत् । वारणेनेव मत्तेन मत्तो वारणयूथपः ॥१०॥
verses.english: Then drawing his bow to the shape of a crescent, Partha proceeded as an infuriated leader of an elephant herd when met by another.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं पृथिव्यामेकवीरयोः । रणमध्ये द्वयोरेवं सुमहल्लोमहर्षणम् ॥११॥
verses.english: Then there took place a great hair-stirring encounter between those two heroes peerless on earth.
verses.bhavadeepa: अर्धचन्द्रम् अर्धचन्द्राकारं ललाटम् । आवृत्य प्रमृज्य स्वेदेन ज्यां प्रमृज्येत्यर्थः । तेन अश्वत्थाम्ना ॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: तौ वीरौ ददृशुः सर्वे कुरवो विस्मयान्विताः । युध्यमानौ महावीर्यौ यूथपाविव संगतौ ॥१२॥
verses.english: The Kurus, all filled with wonder, saw those two highly powerful heroes like two elephant chiefs.

verses.sanskrit: तौ समाजघ्नतुर्वीरावन्योन्यं पुरुषर्षभौ । शरैराशीविषाकारैर्ज्वलद्भिरिव पन्नगैः ॥१३॥
verses.english: With burning arrows of the shape of serpents, those two foremost of men struck each other.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षय्याविषुधी दिव्यौ पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः । तेन पार्थो रणे शूरस्तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः ॥१४॥
verses.english: And because the high-souled son of Pandu, Partha, has a pair of inexhaustible celestials quivers, he remained in battle unmoved like a mountain.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वत्थाम्नः पुनर्बाणाः क्षिप्रमभ्यस्यतो रणे । जग्मुः परिक्षयं तूर्णमभूत् तेनाधिकोऽर्जुनः ॥१५॥
verses.english: Ashvathama's arrows however, being speedily discharged, were all exhausted and for this Arjuna beat him down.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कर्णो महाचापं विकृष्याभ्यधिकं तथा । अवाक्षिपत् ततः शब्दो हाहाकारो महानभूत् ॥१६॥
verses.english: Then drawing to its full his huge bow, Karna twanged it, and thee arose exclamations of Alas!"

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चक्षुर्दधे पार्थो यत्र विस्फार्यते धनुः । ददर्श तत्र राधेयं तस्य कोपो व्यवर्धत ॥१७॥
verses.english: Then Partha looked forward to where from came the twang of the bow and saw the son of Radha, at which his anger was excited.

verses.sanskrit: स रोषवशमापन्नः कर्णमेव जिघांसया । तमैक्षत विवृत्ताभ्यां नेत्राभ्यां कुरुपुङ्गवः ॥१८॥
verses.english: Desirous of slaying Karna and possessed by anger, that foremost of Kurus looked towards him with expanded eyes.

verses.sanskrit: तथा तु विमुखे पार्थे द्रोणपुत्रस्य सायकात् । त्वरिताः पुरुषा राजन्नुपाजह्रुः सहस्रशः ॥१९॥
verses.english: Then Partha going away from the son of Drona, his men, o king, shot thousands of arrows at him (Partha).

verses.sanskrit: उत्सृज्य च महावाहुर्द्रोणपुत्रं धनञ्जयः । अभिदुद्राव सहसा कर्णमेव सपत्नजित् ॥२०॥
verses.english: Leaving behind the son of Drona, the mighty-armed Dhananjaya, the conqueror of enemies, rushed towards Karna.

verses.sanskrit: तमभिद्रुत्य कौन्तेयः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः । कामयन् द्वैरथं तेन युद्धं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥२१॥
verses.english: Approaching him and desiring a duel, the son of Kunti, having his eyes reddened with anger, said.
